title: This Soldier Carried 12 Wounded Men Through Enemy Fire

scenes.headline: 12 MEN
scenes.text: This soldier carried twelve wounded men through enemy fire.

scenes.headline: 12 MEN
scenes.text: On his shoulders. One at a time.

scenes.headline: NEW GUINEA 1943
scenes.text: July, nineteen forty-three. New Guinea. Allied troops attack Japanese positions on Mount Tambu.

scenes.headline: BULL
scenes.text: Leslie Allen is an Australian stretcher-bearer. Big and strong. His mates call him Bull.

scenes.headline: PINNED DOWN
scenes.text: American soldiers fighting beside them are pinned down. Many are hit.

scenes.headline: 2 MEDICS DOWN
scenes.text: Machine guns sweep the slope. Two medics have already been killed.

scenes.headline: HE GOES IN
scenes.text: Bull goes in anyway. He lifts a wounded man onto his shoulders and carries him back.

scenes.headline: AGAIN
scenes.text: Then he goes back. Again. And again.

scenes.headline: 12 MEN
scenes.text: Twelve American soldiers carried out of the fire.

scenes.headline: SILVER STAR
scenes.text: The United States gave him the Silver Star. For bringing those wounded men to safety.

scenes.headline: WOULD YOU?
scenes.text: Would you have gone back a second time?
